name: SMACS J2011.4-5725 (Hubble)
blurb: SMACS J2011.4-5725, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: smacsj201145725-hubble
story: SMACS J2011.4-5725 is a rich, X-ray bright galaxy cluster, a great gathering of galaxies. Hubble took a quick snapshot to find out whether it is a powerful gravitational lens for studying the distant universe.

claims.text: SMACS J2011.4-5725 (SMACSJ2011.4-5725) is a massive galaxy cluster targeted by Hubble program 16670
Hubble program 16670 is a snapshot survey of extreme, X-ray luminous galaxy clusters, seeking powerful gravitational telescopes
The program studies dark and luminous matter in cluster cores
